legend: You are given a deck of n$$$n$$$ cards, each labeled with a number ai$$$a_i$$$. The game begins with an empty hand and an initial total score of zero.

On the i$$$i$$$-th turn, you must pick up the i$$$i$$$-th card with value ai$$$a_i$$$, then optionally discard some cards from your hand, ensuring that after this step, the bitwise XOR[8]$$$^{[8]}$$$ of any two remaining cards in hand is a prime number[11]$$$^{[11]}$$$. The score for this turn is the sum of the values of all cards in your hand, which is then added to the total score.
Determine the maximum possible total score after completing all n$$$n$$$ turns.
input: Each test consists of multiple test cases. The first line contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤50$$$1 \le t \le 50$$$) — the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤150$$$1 \le n \le 150$$$).
The second line of each test case contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ (1≤ai<220$$$1 \le a_i  \lt  2^{20}$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 150$$$150$$$.
output: For each test case, output one line containing a single integer — the maximum score you can get.
note: Cards picked during their respective turns are underlined, while discarded cards are crossed out.
In the first test case, you can process the initial empty hand {}$$$\{\}$$$ and total score 0$$$0$$$ as follows:

after completing the first turn: {1_}$$$\{\underline{1}\}$$$ following removal→$$$\overset{\text{following removal}}{\xrightarrow{\hspace{1.3cm}}}$$$ {1}$$$\{1\}$$$ and a total score of 0+1=1$$$0 + 1 = 1$$$;

after completing the second turn: {1,2_}$$$\{1, \underline{2}\}$$$ following removal→$$$\overset{\text{following removal}}{\xrightarrow{\hspace{1.3cm}}}$$$ {1,2}$$$\{1, 2\}$$$ and a total score of 1+3=4$$$1 + 3 = 4$$$;

after completing the third turn: {1,⧸2,3_}$$$\{1, \not{2}, \underline{3}\}$$$ following removal→$$$\overset{\text{following removal}}{\xrightarrow{\hspace{1.3cm}}}$$$ {1,3}$$$\{1, 3\}$$$ and a total score of 4+4=8$$$4 + 4 = 8$$$. Note that cards with values 2$$$2$$$ and 3$$$3$$$ cannot be held in hand simultaneously since 2⊕3=1$$$2 \oplus 3 = 1$$$, which isn't a prime number. To resolve this, we can discard the card with value 2$$$2$$$;

after completing the fourth turn: {1,3,4_}$$$\{1, 3, \underline{4}\}$$$ following removal→$$$\overset{\text{following removal}}{\xrightarrow{\hspace{1.3cm}}}$$$ {1,3,4}$$$\{1, 3, 4\}$$$ and a total score of 8+8=16$$$8 + 8 = 16$$$;

after completing the fifth turn: {1,3,4,⧸5_}$$$\{1, 3, 4, \not{\underline{5}}\}$$$ following removal→$$$\overset{\text{following removal}}{\xrightarrow{\hspace{1.3cm}}}$$$ {1,3,4}$$$\{1, 3, 4\}$$$ and a total score of 16+8=24$$$16 + 8 = 24$$$.

在第 i$$$i$$$ 轮，你必须拿起第 i$$$i$$$ 张价值为 ai$$$a_i$$$ 的牌，然后可以选择弃掉手中若干张牌，确保此步骤之后，手中任意两张剩余牌的按位异或[8]$$$^{[8]}$$$ 都是一个素数[11]$$$^{[11]}$$$。这一轮的得分为你手中所有牌的价值之和，并累加到总分中。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤50$$$1 \le t \le 50$$$) — 测试用例的数量。接下来是每个测试用例的描述。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行，其中包含一个整数，即你能够获得的最大分数。
